terminus.sourceLayer: The 2012 workshop shows participants hesitating because the submission format looked professional and difficult; willingness increased when organizers relaxed format requirements. The 2015 group record shows a different constraint: the problem was too large, so the group narrowed its target from solving urban renewal to influencing actors who could affect actual plans.
terminus.generatedLayer: MUTHER proposes a PARTICIPATION THRESHOLD model with two separable bottlenecks: entry-format threshold (people may not imagine themselves as eligible to act) and action-scope threshold (the problem may be too large to imagine an effective move). Lowering the first and narrowing the second can convert concern into participation without requiring stronger motivation.

quality.reusability: high as a testable process model

terminus.counterpoint: The model must be tested against cases where lowering format requirements or narrowing scope does not increase participation; motivation, trust or resources may dominate instead.
